summary: Move embedded Security Fusion ownership to standalone Cindertrace. Preserve inventory, durable export, summaries, compatibility redirects and a narrowly authenticated managed response bridge. Existing local-mode installations must migrate security state before upgrading. Historical tables and applied migrations remain intact.

newOptionalEnv.name: CINDERTRACE_RESPONSE_SECRET
newOptionalEnv.description: Dedicated HMAC credential for the optional Cindertrace response bridge.

newOptionalEnv.name: CINDERTRACE_RESTART_ALLOWLIST
newOptionalEnv.description: Services that Cindertrace may request to restart.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_SECURITY_RESPONSE_ENABLED
newOptionalEnv.description: Explicit opt-in to the managed security response adapter.
